name: Marcus Kilburn
tagline: One person. One opinion. A lot of cables.
bio: I started making videos in 2019 because I was tired of tech reviews that read like press releases. Six years and 412 videos later, that's still the only rule: if I wouldn't say it to a friend over coffee, it doesn't go in the script.

Every product on this site was either bought retail, borrowed from a friend, or returned after testing. No review units. No sponsored first impressions. No "this changes everything" thumbnails for products that don't.
The studio is in East London. The editing happens in Tokyo. The opinions are entirely my own and frequently wrong, which I think is fine.

principles.title: If it's sponsored, it says so. Loudly.
principles.note: Three sponsors max per year. Always disclosed. Never the main video.

principles.title: Three-week minimum testing window.
principles.note: No "first impressions" passed off as reviews. If I haven't lived with it, I won't grade it.

principles.title: Numbers over adjectives.
principles.note: "Fast" is meaningless. "47ms latency measured at 1kHz" is something I can defend.

principles.title: Wrong is fine. Lying isn't.
principles.note: When I get something wrong, I update the video and pin the correction. Errors are public.
